based_on: 23 tracked accounts — 7 direct, 8 content, 7 benchmark, 1 platform; 11 with live post-level data this week (66 posts), plus all 74 of IFM's own

patterns.title: News pegs are the only thing producing outlier reach — and it is now reproducible, not luck
patterns.text: IFM's top three reels by views are all news pegs: Tata Sons IPO (14,100 views — 14x the 994 median reel), the Tata boardroom story (2,916) and the NSE IPO (2,071). Nothing evergreen comes close. The two tracked accounts with the best engagement per follower run the same engine: Neha Nagar (33K, 1.32% — the highest in the set) is explicitly news-reactive, and Anushka Rathod (1M, 0.92%) is news-decoded 30-second explainers. Nobody in the 23 is claiming 'money news a mum actually needs'. Make one news-peg reel a fixed weekly slot, not something that happens when there is time.

patterns.title: Static posts are dead weight — IFM's own numbers say 2.7x, and the whole field has already moved
patterns.text: IFM's 43 reels average 37.2 likes; its 30 static posts average 13.6 — 2.7x in favour of video, and all 16 posts in the last 30 days were already reels. The field agrees: Shreyaa Kapoor (580K) pivoted off static to character-driven video, Anushka Rathod is one-concept-per-reel only, LXME calls reels 'the primary growth engine'. Ellevest is the last carousel-led account in the set — and it hid the like count on 3 of its 6 sampled posts. Keep static only where a carousel earns a save (a checklist, an organiser), never as the default.

patterns.title: Per follower IFM already beats every account tracked — the big numbers are pinned history
patterns.text: On last-30-day posts IFM runs 6.0% engagement (34 likes / 570 followers). Every tracked account on current posts: Neha Nagar 1.32%, Anushka Rathod 0.92%, Ellevest 0.14%, Vinita 0.13%, Her First 100K 0.11%, Her Money Talks 0.05%, Monika Halan 0.05%, LXME 0.04%, CA Rachana Ranade 0.02%. Rachana's headline 45.8K average is three pinned 2022–2025 megahits (80K/96K/98K); her actual last-30-day average is 195 likes. Lead proposals and the media kit with engagement rate and views, never follower count — on follower count IFM loses to all of them, and on attention per follower it beats all of them.

patterns.title: The set is going dark — 9 of 66 sampled posts now have no public like count
patterns.text: Shreyaa Kapoor (580K) hid the count on all 6 posts sampled this week, and Ellevest on 3 of 6. That is 9 of 66, and both are accounts whose format IFM is actively learning from. Benchmark those two on cadence, hook grammar and format mix instead of likes, and stop reading a missing number as a weak number — it is a deliberate setting, and it is spreading.

patterns.title: Three proven mechanics exist in the set and none of them exists for Indian mums
patterns.text: The sheet already records each as working for someone else: Bekifaayati's regional-language delivery (reaching an audience the English-first finfluencers cannot), LakshMe's Family Record Book (a take-home artefact that keeps a one-off workshop in the house), and Female Invest's practice tool (letting members act without risking money — IFM already owns this in its games and under-uses it). Meanwhile Her Money Talks runs IFM's exact IRL-workshop model and is sub-scale at 3,639 followers and 2 likes a post. The PTA / school / housing-society channel is open; the cheapest of the three to ship is the mums' money organiser as the lead magnet the funnel still lacks.
